The Ondo State Deputy Governor, Dr Olayide Adelami, has urged Nigerians to vote for President Bola Tinubu in the 2027 presidential election, describing his re-election as a vote for national progress. Adelami said Tinubu had taken bold steps to reform the economy, arguing that his administration should be given another four years to consolidate the reforms. According to a statement issued by his spokesman, John Akinduro, on Saturday, the deputy governor spoke at the presidential campaign rally held in Owo, the headquarters of Owo Local Government Area of the state. He said the reforms embarked upon by the Tinubu administration were necessary to lay a solid foundation for inclusive and sustainable national development, urging Nigerians to choose progress over retrogression. He said, “No president has done what Asiwaju (Tinubu) has done with the economy, and it is the best thing to do in the interest of Nigeria and Nigerians. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Pensioners and civil servants are receiving their monthly pay as and when due, states now have more funds for infrastructural development.” Ondo burglar sells stolen items online 2027: Obi-Kwankwaso ticket going nowhere, says Keyamo Obi contesting 2027 election to remain in the news – Bwala The deputy governor also thanked the people of Owo for their continued support for Governor Lucky Aiyedatiwa, urging them to sustain their backing for the All Progressives Congress ahead of the general elections. He described Aiyedatiwa as a leader chosen at a crucial time to provide exemplary leadership and chart a way forward in governance. Adelami also urged registered voters in Owo and neighbouring communities to collect and safeguard their Permanent Voter Cards and mobilise support for the ruling party. Earlier, the Director-General of the Ondo State APC Presidential Campaign Council, Victor Olabimtan, urged residents of Ose and Owo local government areas to deliver at least 75 per cent of registered voters for the party in the January 16 election. He also urged party members to mobilise support for all APC candidates ahead of the February 6, 2027, House of Assembly election, stressing its importance to the party’s electoral fortunes.
